fabricated_pass_findings.detail: Accepts a live client, calls get_world(), then hardcodes status CAPTURED for rgb/depth/semantic/lidar/gnss/imu, synchronization_status PASS, and gnss_agreement PASS. It subscribes to no sensor and receives no frame.
fabricated_pass_findings.impact: On a map with no absolute origin GNSS emits nothing, yet this still records gnss status CAPTURED and agreement PASS, so any gate reading L9 sees a false success.

fabricated_pass_findings.detail: fps=0, p95_frame_time_ms=0, ram_usage_mb=0, vram_usage_mb=0, rpc_timeouts=0 are all hardcoded while performance_status is reported as PASS.
comparison_status PASS with no comparison performed.

persisted_fabricated_evidence.note: Fabricated PASS evidence is referenced from a certification manifest inside a directory named GITHUB_SHIP. Any prior runtime PASS derived from these files is void.

rationale: Emitting no GNSS measurement is truthful, but silence is indistinguishable from sensor or network failure downstream. Every consumer must either fail fast or declare GNSS optional up front; none may wait indefinitely.
